lead_intakes_consumed_only.name: lead_intakes_consumed_only
lead_intakes_consumed_only.value: "borynx_private"."lead_intakes"."lead_id" is null or "borynx_private"."lead_intakes"."consumed_at" is not null

lead_intakes_scrubbed_on_consumption.name: lead_intakes_scrubbed_on_consumption
lead_intakes_scrubbed_on_consumption.value: "borynx_private"."lead_intakes"."consumed_at" is null or ("borynx_private"."lead_intakes"."brief" is null and "borynx_private"."lead_intakes"."display_name" is null and "borynx_private"."lead_intakes"."company_name" is null)

lead_service_orders_placement_window.name: lead_service_orders_placement_window
lead_service_orders_placement_window.value:
("borynx_private"."lead_service_orders"."sponsor_until" is not null) = ("borynx_private"."lead_service_orders"."kind" = 'sponsored_lead' and "borynx_private"."lead_service_orders"."confirmed_at" is not null)
    and ("borynx_private"."lead_service_orders"."sponsor_until" is null or "borynx_private"."lead_service_orders"."sponsor_until" > "borynx_private"."lead_service_orders"."confirmed_at")

leads_public_open_recent_idx.name: leads_public_open_recent_idx
leads_public_open_recent_idx.where:
"leads"."publication_status" = 'published' and "leads"."is_removed" = false and "leads"."status" = 'open'
        and "leads"."award_needs_review" = false and "leads"."accepted_bid_id" is null and "leads"."assigned_user_id" is null

sessions_intake_requires_identity.name: sessions_intake_requires_identity
sessions_intake_requires_identity.value: "sessions"."intake_id" is null or "sessions"."auth_identity_id" is not null

users_hourly_rate_pair.name: users_hourly_rate_pair
users_hourly_rate_pair.value:
("users"."hourly_rate" is null and "users"."hourly_currency" is null) or
      ("users"."hourly_rate" is not null and "users"."hourly_currency" is not null and "users"."hourly_rate" between 1 and 10000000 and "users"."hourly_currency" in ('USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'))

users_public_company_name_set.name: users_public_company_name_set
users_public_company_name_set.value: not "users"."company_name_public" or ("users"."company_name" is not null and length(trim("users"."company_name")) > 0)
